patch_description: Replace the random point cloud with a deterministic maximin search inside a fixed equilateral convex hull. Three points are fixed at the hull vertices, so the hull area is constant and every optimization step directly improves the normalized minimum triangle area. The remaining ten points are represented by barycentric coordinates, which guarantees that all proposed points remain inside the convex region. A seeded simulated-annealing phase preferentially moves vertices of the currently worst triangle, followed by a deterministic coordinate-polishing phase. This avoids the severe near-collinear triples produced by uniform random sampling while preserving reproducibility.
